dedupe_keys.name: urban form data for climate modelling sydney at 300 m resolution

description: This dataset gives urban morphology and land surface parameters for Sydney on a 300 m grid, derived from building-resolving data and 2 m land cover, for use as input to urban climate models. It was published on Zenodo on 20 May 2022 (version 1.0) by Mathew Lipson, Negin Nazarian and Melissa Hart of the ARC Centre of Excellence for Climate Extremes at UNSW Sydney, Kerry Nice of the University of Melbourne and Brooke Conroy of the University of Wollongong, with the article 'A transformation in city-descriptive input data for urban climate models' (Frontiers in Environmental Science, 2022). It was developed from Geoscape Buildings v2.0, Trees v1.6 and Surface Cover v1.6, copyright Geoscape Australia 2020. Coverage: the Sydney region. Access: one 12 MB zip on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 with attribution; free. Caveats: derived from commercial Geoscape layers, whose terms apply to the source data. Simulation uses: urban climate and heat modelling with realistic building and tree morphology. Related records: GLAMOUR and the World Urban Morphological Parameters dataset.
